name: black-friday-cyber-monday-deals (labex-labs)
accepts: Developer tools, technical learning and software, in categories Security & Privacy, Developer Tools, Cloud & Hosting, AI Tools, Design & Media, Website Builders & Templates, Productivity & Utilities, Business & Marketing. Mac and iOS apps sit under Productivity & Utilities. Curated by LabEx, whose own sale is the first section.
how_to_submit: Pull request adding or updating a row in the category table in README.md. No CONTRIBUTING file, no pull request template, no issue form.
entry_format: | [Name](url) | 50% off | $99.00 · lifetime | `CODE` |  (columns Product, Discount, Sale price, Code; a long dash for missing information)
rules: Keep product names alphabetical within the category and product rows text-only.
Translations go in i18n/README_<language>.md with a link in the language bar; the owner syncs reviewed deals across them.
No deadline for the list; 'follow the product link for dates and full terms'.
status_note: Created 10 Nov 2026. 12 pull requests from outside authors merged between 15 and 17 Nov 2026; 28 open and none merged in the three days to 20 Nov; 3 closed without a merge and without a stated reason.
recommended_for: developer tools and software; Mac and iOS apps under Productivity & Utilities
